claims: Saturday, April 11, 2026 features coverage of the Masters third round.
Masters third round TV coverage airs on CBS from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET.
Masters third round early coverage airs on Paramount+ and Masters.com from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. ET.
Featured groups and holes (Amen Corner) are available on Masters.com and the Masters App throughout the day.
Masters On the Range coverage airs from 10 a.m. to 12 p.m. ET on Masters.com, Masters App, and Paramount+.
Masters Featured Groups coverage airs from 10:15 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET on Masters.com, Masters App, and Paramount+.
Masters Featured Holes (Amen Corner) coverage airs from 11:45 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET on Masters.com, Masters App, and Paramount+.
Masters Round 3 Early Coverage airs from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. ET on Paramount+.
Masters Round 3 CBS Telecast airs from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET on CBS and Paramount+.
Masters.com and Masters App provide free streaming.
Paramount+ streams the CBS broadcast and early coverage.
ESPN App features coverage for subscribers.
